About TexAura

Reshaping spaces. Sustaining futures.

We believe responsible design shouldn't compromise on beauty. By transforming post-consumer textile waste into high-performance interior materials, we deliver solutions that are visually striking, acoustically effective, and sustainably produced.

Our mission: to help businesses and communities build environments that inspire, perform, and endure.

Innovation with Purpose
Turning post-consumer textile waste into high-performance architectural products.
Sustainability as Standard
Aligned with global goals for responsible consumption and resilient urban environments.
Customer-Centric Design
Materials that enhance both aesthetics and functionality across commercial spaces.
Corporate Credibility
Professional standards for quality, fire rating, and structural performance.

Why TexAura

Unlike anything traditional.

♻️
Circular by Design
Every product starts as someone else's textile waste. We close the loop between the fashion industry and the built environment.
🔊
Acoustic Performance
Unlike traditional bricks, TexAura products absorb sound naturally through their compressed fibre structure — no secondary treatment needed.
🎨
Aesthetic Flexibility
From muted naturals to bold terrazzo compositions, our palette emerges from the source material — making every install genuinely one-of-a-kind.
🏗️
Professional Grade
Fire-rated and structurally sound — your sustainability story never comes at the cost of building compliance.

How It Works

From discard to design feature.

01
Textile Collection
Post-industrial and post-consumer waste collected from factories, retailers, and sorting facilities.
02
Shredding & Sorting
Fibres shredded, cleaned, and sorted by density and colour to create consistent raw material batches.
03
Compression Forming
Material heat-pressed into bricks, panels, and forms — bonded without adhesives using the fibres' own interlocking structure.
04
Finished Product
Quality-checked, rated for acoustic and structural performance, and ready to install in commercial environments.
